subject: Hypernet: request for non-standard SLA, payment terms, and pilot pricing
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Blake <k.blake@hypernet.ai>
Cc: Tom Armitage <t.armitage@hypernet.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot commercial terms + SLA ask

Hi Karen — great speaking yesterday. As discussed, Hypernet's pilot with Redwood will be on Dedicated capacity and you asked us to propose an exception path for uptime and credits for the pilot period.

Quick summary of what we put in the draft amendment (attached):
- Pilot term: 12 months, dedicated pool
- Requested SLO (your ask): 99.98% monthly uptime
- Our standard SLO for Dedicated: 99.9%; default service-credit band applies
- Hypernet asks: 25% pilot discount off list, payment terms net45, and a service-credit cap lower than standard

Attached: draft_amendment_hypernet_v1.pdf — we've put a starting point for conversation. Can you confirm the PO timeline? We're aiming to finalize commercials by Sept 21 so we can provision the pool in early October.

Thanks,
Elliot
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: draft_amendment_hypernet_v1.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)

From: Karen Blake <k.blake@hypernet.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Armitage <t.armitage@hypernet.ai>, procurement@hypernet.ai
Date: 2026-09-14T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial terms + SLA ask

Thanks Elliot — saw the draft. A few key internal asks from Legal and Procurement:
- Hypernet needs a tighter uptime commitment for this use case: target 99.98%
- We want service-credit exposure limited (proposed cap: 2x monthly fee or max 2% of monthly invoice)
- Procurement prefers net45; we can provide a PO within two weeks once terms are agreed

Attached is a redline from our counsel with suggested language: hypernet_comments_redline.pdf. My colleague Tom is copied for contract cadence. Happy to jump on another call if useful.

Best,
Karen
VP, Cloud Platforms — Hypernet AI
k.blake@hypernet.ai

Attachment: hypernet_comments_redline.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:45:00Z
Subject: Exec concurrence needed: Hypernet requests non-standard SLA & payment terms

Team — forwarding Hypernet's redline and ask. High level: customer requests 99.98% uptime (vs our 99.9% standard for Dedicated), wants a very low service-credit cap and net45 payment. They are a strategic pilot (large potential ARR) and want a 25% pilot discount.

Proposed compromise to present to Hypernet:
- Offer 99.96% uptime for the pilot (meets in-between their ask and our standard)
- Cap service credits at 3% of monthly invoice for pilot period; credits apply per-month and capped at 3%
- Approve a 20% pilot discount (12-month pilot) — anything beyond 20% needs VP finance approval
- Payment: accept net45 for customer but require initial invoice (first month or setup fee) net30 as a partial-risk mitigation

Asking for quick exec concurrence (Rafael/Rishi) because this deviates from published SLOs and pricing. If we have signoff, I'll send the updated amendment back to Karen and Tom and loop Legal for final language.

Attachments: draft_amendment_hypernet_v1.pdf, hypernet_comments_redline.pdf

— Elliot

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec concurrence needed: Hypernet requests non-standard SLA & payment terms

Elliot — thanks for the summary. I support presenting the compromise below to the customer, with two asks from Deal Desk/Finance:
- Discount: 20% max for pilot (signed MRA). Anything >20% requires VP approval and finance note.
- SLO exception: 99.96% for pilot only, and explicit end-of-pilot rollback to standard SLO unless otherwise negotiated. Legal must add a clause that limits exposure during consecutive failure modes.
- Service credit cap: 3% monthly for pilot; accept customer cap request is too low.
- Payment: net45 acceptable if we secure an initial 30-day deposit invoice as Elliot suggested.

If Rafael or Rishi can confirm, I'll draft the commercial summary and ask Legal to prepare the final amendment language for signoff.

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

(On a process note: include a clause requiring Redwood's fallback policy — e.g., automatic model-variant routing when infra constraints occur — to reduce credit exposure.)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec concurrence needed: Hypernet requests non-standard SLA & payment terms

I reviewed the proposed compromise and approve the following, contingent on Legal & Finance implementing the noted guardrails:
- Approve 20% pilot discount (12-month term) as final commercial concession.
- Approve temporary SLO of 99.96% for the pilot term only. Require explicit rollback clause to standard SLO at pilot end.
- Approve service-credit cap at 3% of monthly invoice for the pilot period (documented in amendment).
- Payment: accept net45 for the customer, but require Finance to sign off on the 45-day term with the initial invoice due net30. If Finance pushes back, we revert to net30.

Legal: include a clause that limits stacking of credits across multiple failure categories and permits Redwood to execute fallback policies (model variant routing, capacity burst to other pools) before credits kick in.

I will countersign an internal approval note once Legal confirms the language.

— Rishi
Head of Commercial Operations
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: exec_approval_note.txt (short internal approval summary)

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Blake <k.blake@hypernet.ai>, Tom Armitage <t.armitage@hypernet.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial terms + SLA ask — Exec concurrence obtained

Karen / Tom — quick update: exec concurrence obtained from Redwood on the compromise below. Summary of what we can commit to (pending Legal amendment):
- Pilot discount: 20% off list for 12 months
- Pilot SLO: 99.96% uptime (pilot-only)
- Service-credit cap: 3% of monthly invoice for the pilot period
- Payment: net45 accepted; Redwood Finance requires first invoice/deposit net30

Next steps: 1) I'll upload the updated amendment to DocuSign and send the routing link; 2) Legal will incorporate the fallback/stacking language flagged by Rishi; 3) Once signed, we provision the dedicated pool.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/route/abc123-hypernet
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HYP-2026-058

Please confirm you received and we will push the DocuSign envelope this morning.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
Elliot
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_hypernet_amendment_signed.pdf (PDF pending: will attach after counter-signature)
